BioLink

Drug-repurposing query interface — ranked candidate drugs for a disease, with evaluation and literature evidence

✓Known treatments in the graph (training edges)

✨Predicted candidate drugs ()

Ranked by link-prediction score over Hetionet compounds, excluding known treatments. Entries marked "held-out true" are real treats edges that were hidden during training, so they show the model recovering true links. Predictions are research hypotheses, not clinical recommendations.

📄Literature associations (BC5CDR test abstracts)

Chemical-induced-disease pairs predicted by the fine-tuned PubMedBERT classifier on the 500 BC5CDR test abstracts. These are adverse-effect associations, shown as supporting context, not as treatment evidence.

📊Evaluation (held-out test data)

Link prediction
Relations
NER
Methodology: NER and relation extraction are trained and tested on the BC5CDR corpus (Li et al., 2016, 1,500 PubMed abstracts). Link prediction (TransE / DistMult / RotatE, implemented in PyTorch) is trained on a Hetionet v1.0 subset (Himmelstein et al., 2017) with 10% of compound-treats-disease edges held out for validation and 10% for testing. Code and results are in the project folder.
